passive.name: Threads of Vibration
passive.text: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.

spells.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
spells.text: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.

spells.name: Seismic Bastion
spells.text: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.

spells.name: Ixtal's Impact
spells.text: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.

spells.name: Impale
spells.text: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.

damage.value: Skarner deals sustained max-Health magic damage through Quaking.

archetype.value: Skarner plays as a tank-style engager who shields himself, charges through terrain, and suppresses enemies.

spikes.at: Q cooldown falls from 8 to 3 seconds
spikes.why: Skarner can empower his attacks and throw boulders more often.

bait.why: Skarner cannot empower his attacks or throw his boulder again until Q is ready.
Skarner cannot use W’s shield, damage, or slow again until it is ready.
Skarner cannot use E to charge through terrain or slam a target into a wall again until it is ready.
